line.name: Joya de Nicaragua Rosalones (CT)
line.background_text: Rosalones is one of Joya de Nicaragua's original, longest-running brands, historically sold mainly in European markets. In 2026 JDN brought Rosalones to the U.S. market for the first time as "Rosalones CT," a Connecticut-seed-wrapped, milder entry in the Rosalones family, alongside the darker Rosalones Reserva. Older international packagings of the base Rosalones/Rosalones Auténticos line (predating the 2026 U.S. launch) used a Habano-seed Colorado Maduro wrapper and different vitola naming (e.g., "552," "448 Consul"), suggesting the blend/wrapper has varied by market and over time.

vitolas.summary_review: Blind Man's Puff rated this a Very Good 90/100, with strong draw, wavy-but-self-correcting burn, and medium-strong/medium-full body.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Wrapper listed as Nicaraguan Criollo, binder Habano, filler Nicaraguan (differs from 2026 U.S. Rosalones CT spec) - likely an earlier/international Rosalones batch.

research_notes: IMPORTANT AMBIGUITY: sources show at least two versions of 'Rosalones' over time - an older/international line (vitola codes like '448 Consul'/'552 Auténticos', wrapper listed variously as Nicaraguan Criollo or Habano 2000 Colorado Maduro) and the newly launched (2026) U.S. 'Rosalones CT' with a Connecticut-seed Ecuador wrapper, Robusto/Toro sizes, boxes of 20. Treated as the same brand family but flagged as a possible historical/market variation rather than fabricated as identical.
